description: This file defines an Android activity 'Bouncer3' with an inner custom view 'MyView' that displays and animates a bitmap with bounce effect using ObjectAnimator.

classes.name: Bouncer3
classes.description: Main activity class that sets the content view.

classes.name: MyView
classes.description: Custom View class that displays a bitmap and performs bounce animation on click.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the layout.

methods.name: setupShape
methods.description: Loads bitmap resource and sets up click listener to start animation.

methods.name: setShapeX
methods.description: Sets the X position of the shape and invalidates the affected area.

methods.name: setShapeY
methods.description: Sets the Y position of the shape and invalidates the affected area.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Centers the shape horizontally when view size changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the bitmap at current position.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Creates and starts an ObjectAnimator to animate the shapeY property.

methods.name: getObjectAnimator
methods.description: Returns an ObjectAnimator that animates 'shapeY' from 0 to the bottom of the view minus bitmap height.
